model_outputs.late_probability: P(invoice clears after adjusted due date)
model_outputs.delay_over_7d_probability: P(invoice becomes more than 7 days late)
model_outputs.delay_over_15d_probability: P(invoice becomes more than 15 days late)
model_outputs.conditional_expected_days_late: Expected days late conditional on being late
model_outputs.conservative_clearance_window_days: Conservative clearance-window estimate conditional on being late (P80 internally)

derived_outputs.severity: derived from late_probability, delay_over_7d_probability, delay_over_15d_probability and conditional lateness
derived_outputs.collection_priority: policy-derived from exposure, risk, severity and due-date urgency
derived_outputs.intervention_recommendation: deterministic policy output; not an independently trained target

important_constraints: P(>15d) should never exceed P(>7d) at serving time; enforce monotonic post-processing.
These models do not estimate causal intervention effectiveness.
Reserved test split remains untouched during development.
